name: @godrix/sonarqube-mcp
description: MCP Server for seamless SonarQube integration. Enables AI-driven code quality analysis and interaction with SonarQube metrics and insights.

scripts.dev: npm run build && export DANGEROUSLY_OMIT_AUTH=true && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node /build/server.js
scripts.dev:mcp: npm run build && DANGEROUSLY_OMIT_AUTH=true npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector --config .cursor/inspector.json --server sonarqube-mcp
scripts.pack:mcpb:slim: npm run build && rm -rf node_modules && npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts && npx --yes @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack

author: Godrix
